title: a response keeps the headers it came with
line: a connector's response is archived with the HTTP status, ETag and Last-Modified it came with on its artifact row as on its manifest: the New Jersey death index's file carries the Internet Archive's own; the surname's rows the runner computes from it came with no response and carry none

steps.say: the death record the file cites for Frederick Micheal Ahearn Jr, run through the real death index connector: the file's lines played back with the headers the Internet Archive served them with

expect.why: the whole file and the surname's rows archived, the rows the record
the file's row carries the status, ETag and Last-Modified the holder served it with, as its manifest does
the surname's rows were computed from the file in hand, no request of their own: no response, no headers
